notes: Curated eval for the craft-pass output contract. Routing prompts stay on practitioner language; output checks require the skill's leading test, not a section list.

should_trigger.prompt: Please extract credible customer stories, proof points, outcome claims, and approved quotes from notes, transcripts, and source data.
Please turn customer evidence into an internal proof story, case-study draft, quote bank, or publication-ready evidence packet.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable case study and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please synthesize multi-source field feedback into traceable themes, segment differences, evidence limits, and owner-ready actions for enablement, product marketing, sales leadership, or product.
Please package a defined or approved narrative into a concise one-pager, an assertion-led slide outline, or both from supplied source material.
Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.

output_structure_checks.name: case-study-extractor-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps evidence strength separate from publication permission. Quotes are exact. Metrics include baseline, period, and attribution limit.

output_structure_checks.name: case-study-extractor-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
